== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Krayt Dragon Bones (V) (Errata)]] (<code>1240_29</code>, Virtual Block 4 slip 30E), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 4 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB4-30E-Krayt_Dragon_Bones.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB4-D-kraytdragonbones-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Krayt Dragon Bones (V)]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock4Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064721/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111144021/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive). The card list drops icons; the icons are those of the printed slip. Published typos are kept as printed.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Deploy on table. Womp Rats are not [Selective Creature]. Once per turn, may deploy a creature (except a parasite) or a dewback from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Your ferocious creatures are deploy -2 and ferocity +1. Whenever you retrieve Force because a creatue has eaten a card, you need only use X-2 Force for Aim High (to a minimum of 1). (Immune to Alter.)”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1240_29</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 4 set mark, slip number 30E, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
